ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 11.7 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 3, 2026-06-30: 3.3) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 2.7, 2025-06-30: 3)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2008-12-31..2026-06-30; paid facts exist only inside that span and are not used; the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2018-09-30) is 2830 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

buybacks.basis: not filed for any of the four quarters

dividends.price_note: price: neither prices.json nor score.json carries a price — yields null
dividends.shares_source: quarter ended 2026-06-30 weighted-average diluted count, fallback: no undimensioned period-end / cover-page share count in EDGAR companyfacts (a dual-class filer's cover-page and balance-sheet counts are class-dimensioned and dropped by the API)
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks NOT INCLUDED (not filed for any of the four quarters) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
